name: PAWS-X: Cross-Lingual Paraphrase Adversaries from Word Scrambling
description: PAWS-X is an adversarial multilingual paraphrase identification dataset covering seven languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. It consists of sentence pairs with high lexical overlap and word scrambling that test a model's sensitivity to word order and syntactic structure.
